C0863.title: 360 Report Details June 2025 Double/Multiple Extortion Trends and wxx Family Delivery Methods
C0863.summary: A 360 Security Guard ransomware trend report published on July 9, 2025 said that WarLock, Kawa4096, TeamXXX, and other double-extortion ransomware families newly appeared worldwide in June 2025, and that 478 organizations were listed as victims of double or multiple extortion. In its keyword ranking, wxx was identified as part of the Weaxor family, mainly delivered through software vulnerability exploitation and manual deployment after brute-forcing Remote Desktop passwords.
